# rwx_service_account (Resource)

Manages RWX service-account metadata without issuing credentials or managing permissions. Import by the stable service-account ID. Renaming the display name preserves identity and the immutable name. Destroy deactivates the account, revokes its tokens, and ends its group memberships.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rwx_service_account" "deploy" {
  display_name = "Deploy automation"
  description  = "Deploys releases"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The display name, unique among active service accounts in the organization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The service-account description. Omit to clear the description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stable service-account ID.
- `identity_id` (String) The stable identity ID.
- `name` (String) The server-generated immutable reference name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_service_account.deploy 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
